usageNotes: Returns the APT sub-resource directory for a specific node, listing the available child endpoints (e.g., update, changelog, versions). Use this as a discovery call to confirm which APT operations are accessible before invoking them. The node must be online and reachable by the cluster; no special privilege is required beyond basic authenticated access.

examples.summary: List available APT sub-resources on node pve1

tips: The response is a directory index, not a package list — use get_nodes_node_apt_update to retrieve pending package updates.
Accessible to all authenticated users (permissions: user=all), so no admin token is needed for this call.
Child resource IDs returned here map directly to sub-paths under /nodes/{node}/apt/ for subsequent calls.
